project: 黎黎隆项目/角色魅力实验

character_asset.workbuddy_action: upload the original JPEG and use ADV-001 identity sheet for visual validation

hourly_environment.selection_rule: Each hourly run may select one primary scene and one secondary scene from the 13-scene pool after WorkBuddy confirms the character reference.

must_keep: dark beard and tired experienced face
dark teal-black layered cloak with purple and red panels
backpack, rolled equipment and cyan-lit lantern

ten_yuan.chain_translation: accumulated travel → equipment system → equipment burden → lantern becomes guidance and protection

b_hourly_output.first_experiment: A 10–15 second scene showing the adventurer carrying heavy equipment through darkness, stopping to adjust the burden, then raising the cyan lantern to protect or guide another person.
b_hourly_output.prompt_rule: Use ten-yuan symbols internally; final H3 prompt must describe only visible character, scene, action, change and result.

handoff.b_end: Use ADV-001 as an independent selectable character in the hourly environment.
handoff.cloud_work: Bind the original JPEG manually or from the local task package, validate identity first, then render the selected hourly task.
